subject: Life Skills
title: Water Damage Prevention
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Water Damage Prevention.

hook.text: Water damage is the second most common home insurance claim, costing billions globally each year.

buildup.text: Slow leaks under sinks and behind walls cause more total damage than dramatic pipe bursts.

discovery.text: Check under every sink monthly. A musty smell or warped wood signals a hidden leak already in progress.

twist.text: Your washing machine hoses are a top failure point. Rubber hoses degrade and can burst without warning.

climax.text: Know where your main water shutoff valve is. In a burst, seconds matter and searching wastes all of them.

punchline.text: Find the shutoff valve today, not during a flood.

quiz.question: What is the most important thing to know for water emergencies?
options: Which pipes are newest in your home
Where the main water shutoff valve is located
How to patch a pipe with tape
